s.note: Ben's house full of slacker mates
s.how: Spread 300g corn chips on a tray, add a tin of refried beans and 200g grated cheese and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Top with salsa.
Slice 1 jar dill pickles into spears and serve on a plate beside 4 scoops of vanilla ice cream. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: dinner on the run in LA
m.how: Fry 3 tbsp green curry paste, add 400ml coconut milk and 800g sliced chicken thigh and simmer 15 minutes. Add 1 sliced capsicum, beans and basil. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.how: Beat 125g butter and 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes and ice with 150g butter beaten with 300g icing sugar and a drop of colouring.

d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 150ml grape juice and a squeeze of lime to each and top with soda water and mint. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
